attributes.name: Druva - Backup Profile Created or Updated
attributes.description: Detects creation or modification of backup profiles that may alter workload coverage or protection behavior.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 0 – Core Cyber Resilience
meta.customer_usecase: Detects creation or modification of backup profiles that may alter workload coverage or protection behavior.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(
    COALESCE(
      TO_STRING(message),
      TO_STRING(druva.event_type),
      ""
    )
  )

| WHERE
    event_text LIKE "*backup profile*creat*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*backup profile*updat*"
    OR event_text LIKE "*new backup profile*"

| EVAL event_time =
    @timestamp

| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name)
  )

| EVAL profile = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(druva.profile.name),
    TO_STRING(druva.resource.name)
  )
